description: The Cackler's, at a mile — and the matriarch's, at six. Catalogued so the vocabulary is complete; this engine resolves no signature for it yet.
name: Blood Nostril

description: Ordinary sight. Reece, 2026-08-31: the senses are what grant a creature the ability to see, so a creature with no vision grant is blind — it is a lack of a sense, not a condition. 60 m is the standard grant; ranges are per-creature and relative (a bat sees poorly and is not blind), and the fuller vocabulary of vision kinds comes later.
name: Color Vision

description: Nineteen Batkin already have this at 30 m. Catalogued so the vocabulary is complete; this engine resolves no signature for it yet.
name: Echolocation

description: Smells reactive material — powder, and the charges built out of it. Reports HOW MUCH is within reach; how well it can say WHERE depends on how far it reaches, and a nose that carries far cannot name a square.
name: Scent

description: Reece, 2026-09-28: two nodes on the Channeler tree; starting out it lets them see the exact Endurance a creature has, for creatures within 5 m; as the branch progresses they also see wounds, and at a much greater distance. The nodes carry the growth.
name: Soul Sight
